The '''Maladi sector''' lay in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] and the [[Kossa sector/Legends|Kossa sector]] [[spinward]]. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] also formed a four-way border with the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous]], [[Parcelus sector/Legends|Parcelus]], and [[Venzeiia sector/Legends|Venzeiia sectors]] at its southern edge, and was a part of the Expansion Region's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

The Maladi sector contained the [[Maladi system/Legends|eponymous star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and also shared its name with the cult of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] known as the [[Maladian]]s.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> The [[Nanth'ri Trade Route/Legends|Nanth'ri Trade Route]]<ref name="Nanth'ri Route" /> [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] passed through the southern reaches of the sector.<ref name="Expansion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maladi sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares N-12, O-11, and O-12.<ref name="Expansion" />
